courses.$comment: The BACHELORS edition of the capstone (Moodle course id 1447, "2026 - Milan & Gland - Capstone: AI for Good - Bachelors"), built 6 Oct 2026 as an independent copy of SUMAS/wind (the online Masters edition) with its own namespace, start date and forums. Same ten weeks, same forums, same phases; differs in START (Mon 19 Oct 2026 — ASSUMED from Moodle's "available from 18 October", a Sunday), the undergraduate letter-grade scale, a live-streamed Zoom lesson slot (schedule.js LIVE, time unknown), Bachelor-level framing in Weeks 4–5, and a glossary.html. The showcase, report PDF and og-image are linked from SUMAS/wind by absolute path, not copied. The rules block for `capstone-ba` must be deployed before the link goes to students. A fix in one folder reaches the other only if ported by hand.

desc.en: A SUMAS MBA research showcase — Europe's energy mix, four 2040 scenarios, and the Ørsted vs TotalEnergies playbooks. Open access.
